prompt: Holly's sweet fruit cake (can / to make) very easily.

prompt: All your heavy boxes (should / not / to leave) near the stairs.

prompt: Every class photo (will / to send) by email tonight.

prompt: Small pet dogs (can / to bring) into the cabin.

prompt: Pupils (will / to take) to the city museum by bus.

prompt: Top science students ___ free study books this term.

prompt: Hi Molly, Oscar's birthday letter (will / to send) today!

prompt: Dinner orders (cannot / to make) after ten at night.

prompt: Soft cotton shirts ___ in cool water at home.

prompt: During our history lesson tomorrow, several local stories ___ by our whole class.

prompt: Fresh daily soup menus (can / to write) on our board.
